noInherit.description: If true, the annotation is not inherited by mixins.

title:
An {@link Annotation} to specify if we should build nested data specs for a component.
Adding this annotation will execute logic to build the path to a component's data spec
by traversing through its' component configuration. This annotation should be used only when
the component is expected to have nested data specs.
name: Ann.UiBuildNestedDataSpecs
